QUOTE: `LlamaCppTokenizer::detokenize` (lines 86–105) calls `llama_token_to_piece` with a 256-byte stack buffer. If that is too small, it resizes to the reported size and calls again.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states detokenize tries a 256-byte stack buffer first and only resizes when it is too small. It also contrasts this with tokenize's size-first pattern: a null-buffer probe, then an allocation and a fill.
